item.description:
Typora Wiki — Implementation Guide

A personal Markdown knowledge base (authored in Typora / Obsidian / any editor) that is automatically built into a Hugo static site and published as GitHub Pages.

Covers: full project structure, feature list, tech stack, CI pipeline, all custom components, and step-by-step replication instructions for GitHub.com or GHE.

1. What You Get

Feature Description
Auto-sidebar Hugo + Hextra generate the left nav tree from wiki/* directory structure
Full-text search FlexSearch, runs entirely offline in the browser
Dual dark themes Terminal Basic Dark (VS Code aesthetic) and TokyoNight Night, toggled in-page
Drag-to-resize sidebar Right-edge drag handle, width persisted in localStorage
Sidebar collapse Single-click hide/show, floating restore button, persisted
Full-width layout toggle Removes Hextra’s max-width caps for wide tables/diagrams
Outline (TOC) toggle Per-page hide/show for the right-side Table of Contents
Category & keyword badges Front matter fields rendered as clickable chips below each page title
Private pages (AES-256) access_type: private encrypts individual pages or entire sections
PI scrubbing Regex scrubber removes phone numbers, emails, secrets from built HTML
Code file viewer pages Auto-generated .md wrappers for .py, .sh, .ts, etc. under wiki/*
Workspace mounts Sync external directories (e.g. ~/.agents) into wiki/mounts/* at build time
Math (KaTeX) $inline$ and $$block$$ rendering via Hextra built-in
Mermaid diagrams Built in to Hextra via fenced code blocks
FOUC-free state restore All layout preferences (theme, sidebar width, collapsed, toc-hidden) restored before first paint

2. Tech Stack

Layer Choice Notes
Static site generator Hugo (≥ 0.146.0 extended) Single Go binary, no Ruby/Node runtime needed
Theme Hextra (imfing/hextra) Ships FlexSearch, KaTeX, Mermaid, sidebar, TOC, shortcodes
Syntax highlighting Chroma (Hugo built-in) dracula style; overridden per-theme via CSS
CI / build runner GitHub Actions — self-hosted runner macOS laptop runs the runner; no cloud runner needed
Pages deployment actions/upload-pages-artifact@v2 + actions/deploy-pages@v2 GitHub Actions deployment mode only — legacy branch mode does not work on GHE
Private page encryption staticrypt (cli) AES-256-CBC, password injected via CI secret
Front matter injection add_front_matter.py (Python 3) Title + date + draft auto-added; user fields preserved
Code page generation gen_code_pages.py (Python 3) Wraps source files in syntax-highlighted Hugo pages
PI scrubbing pi_scrub.py (Python 3) Regex scrub of built HTML before deployment
Workspace sync mount_sync.py (Python 3) Mirror external dirs into wiki/mounts/* pre-build
Theme switching Vanilla JS + CSS custom properties ~50 lines, no framework dependency

3. Repository Structure 

<repo-root>/
├── hugo.yaml # Hugo site config (baseURL, theme, params)
├── wiki/ # ALL authored content (Hugo contentDir)
│ ├── _index.md # Site root index
│ ├── <section>/
│ │ ├── _index.md # Section index (auto-created if missing)
│ │ └── *.md # Pages
│ └── <mount-id>/ # Auto-synced external workspaces
│ ├── _index.md # Committed; content auto-synced from source
│ └── ...
├── assets/ # Images, data files (not Hugo pages)
│ └── css/
│ └── custom.css # All theme overrides (~600 lines)
├── layouts/
│ └── _partials/
│ └── custom/
│ ├── head-end.html # FOUC prevention + sidebar controls + drag-resize + TOC toggle
│ ├── content-begin.html # Category/keyword/access badges below page title
│ └── navbar-end.html # Theme toggle button in navbar
├── static/
│ ├── .nojekyll # Prevents GHE from running Jekyll on gh-pages branch
│ └── assets/ # Fonts, icons, images served at /assets/
├── themes/
│ └── hextra/ # Hugo theme (git subtree or download)
├── .github/
│ ├── mounts.yaml # Mount registry (source dirs → wiki/mounts/<id>/)
│ ├── scripts/
│ │ ├── add_front_matter.py # Inject Hugo front matter into wiki/*.md
│ │ ├── gen_code_pages.py # Auto-generate .md wrappers for code files
│ │ ├── mount_sync.py # Sync external dirs into wiki/mounts/
│ │ ├── pi_scrub.py # Redact PI from built HTML
│ │ ├── encrypt_private.py # Encrypt private pages with staticrypt
│ │ └── staticrypt-template.html # Custom unlock page template
│ └── workflows/
│ └── pages.yml # Primary CI: build + scrub + encrypt + deploy
└── actions-runner/ # Self-hosted runner binary (not committed)

4. Data Flow 

Author writes wiki/**/*.md
│
▼ git push → triggers pages.yml
│
[CI Step 1] mount_sync.py
- reads .github/mounts.yaml
- rsync external source dirs → wiki/mounts/<id>/
- mirror mode: deletions propagate; protects committed _index.md
│
▼
[CI Step 2] gen_code_pages.py wiki/ --clean
- for each *.py/.sh/.ts/etc in wiki/, auto-generate <name>.md
- idempotent: only rewrites when source SHA-256 changes
│
▼
[CI Step 3] add_front_matter.py wiki/ --hugo --ensure-indexes
- injects title/date/draft into .md files missing front matter
- creates _index.md for any subdirectory that lacks one
- never overwrites user-set fields (access_type, categories, keywords)
│
▼
[CI Step 4] hugo --minify --gc
- builds wiki/ → public/
- outputs HTML, CSS (fingerprinted), JS, search index
│
▼
[CI Step 5] pi_scrub.py ./public
- regex-scrubs built HTML (phones, RRN, non-org emails, API keys, CCNs)
- writes redaction log to /tmp/pi-scrub-logs/ (not committed)
│
▼
[CI Step 6] encrypt_private.py
- walks wiki/**/_index.md for cascade: {access_type: private}
- calls staticrypt --recursive on matching public/ dirs
- per-file encryption for non-cascaded private pages
- password from CI secret PERSONAL_SECTION_PASSWORD
│
▼
[CI Step 7] upload-pages-artifact@v2 → deploy-pages@v2
- GitHub Actions deployment mode (build_type: workflow)
- deploys public/ to GitHub Pages
https://<host>/pages/<user>/<repo>/

5. Front Matter Schema

Every page in wiki/ uses YAML front matter. Auto-injected fields are managed by add_front_matter.py; user fields must be set manually.

---
title: "My Page Title" # [auto] inferred from filename
date: 2026-06-05 # [auto] file creation date
draft: false # [auto] skip for unpublished pages

# User-managed (optional) — never overwritten by scripts:
access_type: "private" # page encrypted with staticrypt
categories: ["dev", "notes"] # generates /categories/<slug>/ listing pages
keywords: ["hugo", "wiki"] # meta keywords; rendered as non-clickable tags
weight: 10 # sidebar sort order (lower = first)
cascade: # propagate to ALL child pages
 access_type: private  # encrypts the entire section
---

Section _index.md supports cascade:

---
title: "Private Section"
cascade:
 access_type: private  # encrypts the entire section
---

6. Theme Design

Terminal Basic Dark (default theme)

Inspired by macOS Terminal “Basic” dark profile + VS Code Dark+. All body text uses monospace fonts — the defining terminal aesthetic.

CSS Variable Value Role
--hx-color-dark #1e1e1e Page/sidebar background
--primary-hue/sat/light 170° 46% 55% Accent color (terminal teal #4ec9b0)
--hx-font-sans Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', monospace Body font
--wiki-text-primary #d4d4d4 Body text
--wiki-bg-sidebar #252526 Sidebar background
--wiki-bg-code #0d0d0d Code block background

TokyoNight Night (alternate theme)

Port of folke/tokyonight.nvim Night variant. Activated via <html data-wiki-theme="tokyonight">.

CSS Variable Value Role
--hx-color-dark #1a1b26 Page background
--primary-hue/sat/light 225° 89% 73% Accent (Tokyo blue #7aa2f7)
--wiki-text-primary #c0caf5 Body text
--wiki-bg-sidebar #16161e Sidebar background
--hx-font-sans 'JetBrains Mono', Menlo, Monaco, monospace Body font

Theme switching (no framework) 

Toggle button (navbar) → click → flip localStorage["wiki-theme"]
→ set <html data-wiki-theme="...">
FOUC prevention (inline script) → read localStorage at parse time
→ set class/attribute before first paint
CSS → selects via html[data-wiki-theme="tokyonight"] { ... }

7. Sidebar Interactive Features

All implemented in layouts/_partials/custom/head-end.html (vanilla JS, ~250 lines). State for all features is persisted in localStorage.

Controls Bar (injected at sidebar top) 

[ tokyo ] [ full-wide ] [ collapse ]
theme layout sidebar
  • Theme toggle: cycles terminal-dark ↔ tokyonight
  • Full-width toggle: adds wiki-fullwide class to <html>, removing Hextra’s max-width caps site-wide
  • Sidebar collapse: adds wiki-sidebar-collapsed to <html>, hides <aside>, injects floating expand button (position: fixed, top-left)

Drag-to-resize

Hextra hardcodes 256px. Override:

@media (min-width: 768px) {
 aside.hextra-sidebar-container {
 width: var(--wiki-sidebar-width, 256px) !important;
 position: relative; /* needed for absolute drag handle child */
 }
}

JS injects a 5px absolute div.wiki-sidebar-resize-handle at the right edge. mousedown captures initial width; mousemove clamps to 160–520px and updates --wiki-sidebar-width on <html>. mouseup persists to localStorage.

Outline (TOC) Toggle

  • Injects a hide button at the top of nav.hextra-toc
  • Hide adds wiki-toc-hidden to <html> → nav.hextra-toc { display: none }
  • Article column expands automatically. Floating restore button mirrored to right viewport edge.

8. Private Pages

Pages or sections marked access_type: private are encrypted before deployment.

# wiki/personal/_index.md:
cascade:
 access_type: private  # entire section encrypted

# wiki/others/secret-note.md:
access_type: private  # single page encrypted

encrypt_private.py workflow:

  1. Walks wiki/**/_index.md to find private sections (cascade) and individual pages.
  2. For whole sections: staticrypt --recursive public/<section>/*
  3. For single pages: staticrypt public/<page>/index.html
  4. Password: CI secret PERSONAL_SECTION_PASSWORD (set in repo Settings → Secrets).

Sidebar gating (head-end.html):

Private section children are hidden in the sidebar unless the current page is inside that section. Section title click redirects to the encrypted index page (triggers staticrypt password prompt) instead of expanding in-place.

Installation: 

npm install -g @staticrypt/cli # or npx staticrypt

9. PI Scrubber

Runs on the built public/ directory before deployment.

Patterns scrubbed from HTML files:

Pattern Regex (simplified) Replacement
Korean mobile phone 01[016789]-?\d{3,4}-?\d{4} [PHONE REDACTED]
Korean RRN \d{6}-[1-4]\d{6} [RRN REDACTED]
Personal email non-org @ addresses [EMAIL REDACTED]
API key / secret (api_key|token|secret)\s*[:=]\s*\S{8,} [SECRET REDACTED]
Credit card 16-digit groups [CCN REDACTED]

Add literal strings to the list in the script to prevent false positives.

10. Workspace Mounts

.github/mounts.yaml defines external directories to sync into wiki/mounts/<id>/ before each build. Useful for publishing agent harness, project docs, etc.

mounts:
 - id: my-notes
 label: "My Notes"
 source: "~/Documents/my-notes" # local path, ~ expanded
 access: private # cascade access_type: private to all children
 include_ext: [.md, .txt, .yaml]
 exclude_dirs: [.git, __pycache__]
 exclude_names: [.DS_Store]

mount_sync.py mirrors the source into wiki/mounts/my-notes/ (deletions propagate; committed _index.md is never overwritten). Add to .gitignore: wiki/mounts/my-notes/** (except _index.md).

11. Step-by-step Replication

Prerequisites 

brew install hugo # macOS; must be "extended" version for SCSS
hugo version # verify ≥ 0.146.0 extended
pip3 install pyyaml # needed by add_front_matter.py and encrypt_private.py
npm install -g @staticrypt/cli # needed only if using private pages

Step 1 — Create the repo

Create a new repo on GitHub.com or GHE. Enable GitHub Pages: Settings → Pages → Source: GitHub Actions (not “Deploy from a branch”).

Step 2 — Add Hextra theme 

cd <repo-root>
mkdir -p themes

# Option A: git subtree (recommended — no submodule complexity)
git subtree add --prefix themes/hextra \
 https://github.com/imfing/hextra main --squash

# Option B: download tarball
curl -L https://github.com/imfing/hextra/archive/refs/heads/main.tar.gz | \
 tar xz -C themes/ && mv themes/hextra-main themes/hextra

Step 3 — Configure hugo.yaml

Key settings:

baseURL: "https://<host>/pages/<username>/<repo>/"
# GHE: "https://<ghe-host>/pages/<username>/<repo>/"

taxonomies:
 category: categories

markup:
 highlight:
 noClasses: false
 style: dracula
 goldmark:
 renderer:
 unsafe: true # allow raw HTML in Markdown

outputs:
 home: [HTML, RSS]
 section: [HTML, RSS]

contentDir: wiki
publishDir: public

params:
 theme:
 default: dark
 displayToggle: false # theme toggle is custom, not Hextra's built-in
 search:
 enable: true
 type: flexsearch
 katex: true

Step 4 — Create initial content 

mkdir -p wiki
cat > wiki/_index.md << 'EOF'
---
title: "My Wiki"
---
EOF

# Create sections
mkdir -p wiki/notes wiki/projects wiki/tools
for dir in wiki/notes wiki/projects wiki/tools; do
 echo -e "---\ntitle: \"$(basename $dir | sed 's/.*/\u&/')\"\n---" > "$dir/_index.md"
done

Step 5 — Add custom layouts

Copy the four custom files from this project:

  • assets/css/custom.css → paste into your repo at same path
  • layouts/_partials/custom/head-end.html
  • layouts/_partials/custom/content-begin.html
  • layouts/_partials/custom/navbar-end.html

Step 6 — Add CI scripts

Copy from this project:

  • .github/scripts/pi_scrub.py — required if content has PI risk
  • .github/scripts/add_front_matter.py — required
  • .github/scripts/gen_code_pages.py — optional (code file viewer)
  • .github/scripts/mount_sync.py + .github/mounts.yaml — optional (workspace sync)
  • .github/scripts/encrypt_private.py + staticrypt-template.html — optional (private pages)

Step 7 — Add GitHub Actions workflow

.github/workflows/pages.yml:

name: Deploy Hugo site to Pages

on:
 push:
 branches: [main]
 workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
 contents: read
 pages: write
 id-token: write

concurrency:
 group: "pages"
 cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
 deploy:
 environment:
 name: github-pages
 url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
 runs-on: self-hosted  # change to ubuntu-latest for GitHub-hosted runner
 steps:
 - uses: actions/checkout@v3
 with:
 submodules: false

 - name: Sync mounted workspaces
 run: python3 .github/scripts/mount_sync.py
 # Remove this step if not using workspace mounts

 - name: Prepare content
 run: |
 python3 .github/scripts/gen_code_pages.py wiki/ --clean
 python3 .github/scripts/add_front_matter.py wiki/ --hugo --ensure-indexes

 - name: Build with Hugo
 env:
 HUGO_ENVIRONMENT: production
 run: hugo --minify --gc

 - name: PI scrub
 run: python3 .github/scripts/pi_scrub.py ./public --log-dir /tmp/pi-scrub-logs
 # Remove this step if not using PI scrubbing

 - name: Encrypt private pages
 env:
 STATICRYPT_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.PERSONAL_SECTION_PASSWORD }}
 run: |
 [ -z "$STATICRYPT_PASSWORD" ] && echo "No secret set, skipping." && exit 0
 python3 .github/scripts/encrypt_private.py
 # Remove this step if not using private pages

 - uses: actions/configure-pages@v3
 - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v2
 with:
 path: './public'
 - id: deployment
 uses: actions/deploy-pages@v2

For GitHub-hosted runner: change runs-on: self-hosted to runs-on: ubuntu-latest and add a Hugo install step:

 - name: Setup Hugo
 uses: peaceiris/actions-hugo@v3
 with:
 hugo-version: 'latest'
 extended: true

Step 8 — Self-hosted runner (optional, but recommended for private wikis)

A self-hosted runner lets the CI access local filesystem paths (workspace mounts) without uploading them to GitHub.

# In the repo: Settings → Actions → Runners → New self-hosted runner
# Follow the on-screen instructions; runner binary goes to actions-runner/.
cd <repo-root>/actions-runner
./config.sh --url <repo-url> --token <token>

# Start (loop — restart on exit code 2):
while true; do
 ./run.sh
 [ $? -eq 2 ] && continue || break
done

macOS auto-start: use launchd with a plist pointing to the start loop script.

Step 9 — Set secrets

If using private pages, add the repository secret: Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions → New repository secret

  • Name: PERSONAL_SECTION_PASSWORD
  • Value: <your passphrase>

Step 10 — First deploy 

git add -A && git commit -m "initial wiki setup"
git push origin main
# CI triggers automatically; Pages URL appears under Settings → Pages

12. GHE vs GitHub.com Differences

Aspect GitHub.com GHE (Enterprise Server)
Pages URL pattern https://<user>.github.io/<repo>/ https://<ghe-host>/pages/<user>/<repo>/
Pages deployment mode Both workflow and legacy branch work workflow mode only (legacy branch mode shows “status: built” but serves 404)
Hugo binary on runner Need peaceiris/actions-hugo on hosted runner Pre-installed on self-hosted macOS runner via brew install hugo
gh CLI host GH_HOST env var not needed Set GH_HOST=<ghe-host> for all gh commands
staticrypt Standard npm install Same

Critical GHE note: always keep Pages configured as Settings → Pages → Source: “GitHub Actions”. If it gets set incorrectly, recover with:

GH_HOST=<ghe-host> gh api -X PUT repos/<user>/<repo>/pages -f build_type="workflow"
GH_HOST=<ghe-host> gh workflow run pages.yml -R <user>/<repo> --ref main

13. Adding a New Section 

mkdir -p wiki/<section-name>
cat > wiki/<section-name>/_index.md << 'EOF'
---
title: "Section Title"
weight: 50
---
EOF

Then write .md pages in the directory. On next git push, CI auto-injects front matter and creates any missing _index.md files.

For a private section:

# wiki/<section-name>/_index.md
---
title: "Private Section"
weight: 50
cascade:
 access_type: private
---

Add wiki/<section-name>/** to .gitignore (except _index.md) if the content should not be committed to the repo (e.g. synced from a local workspace via mounts).

14. Key Files Reference

File Purpose
hugo.yaml Site config: baseURL, theme, taxonomies, params
wiki/ All authored Markdown content
assets/css/custom.css Terminal Dark + TokyoNight CSS variables, sidebar/TOC/controls styles
layouts/_partials/custom/head-end.html FOUC prevention, private sidebar gating, controls bar JS, drag-resize, TOC toggle
layouts/_partials/custom/content-begin.html Category/keyword/access badges rendered below page title
layouts/_partials/custom/navbar-end.html Theme toggle button in top navbar
static/.nojekyll Prevents GitHub Pages from running Jekyll on the built output
.github/mounts.yaml External workspace mount registry
.github/scripts/add_front_matter.py Inject/update Hugo front matter in wiki/*.md
.github/scripts/gen_code_pages.py Auto-generate syntax-highlighted pages for code files
.github/scripts/mount_sync.py Mirror external dirs into wiki/mounts/ at build time
.github/scripts/pi_scrub.py Regex-scrub PI from built HTML
.github/scripts/encrypt_private.py staticrypt-encrypt private pages before deploy
.github/workflows/pages.yml CI: build → scrub → encrypt → deploy to GitHub Pages

Typora Wiki — UX Interactions Reference

This document describes every interactive UI feature of the Typora Wiki (Hugo + Hextra theme), including the JavaScript logic, CSS overrides, DOM structure, localStorage state, and FOUC prevention strategy. Use it as a companion to IMPLEMENTATION.md.

1. Sidebar Tree Structure

Hextra auto-generates the left sidebar from the wiki/ directory tree.

Level What provides it How to configure
Root nodes Top-level dirs under wiki/ weight in _index.md (lower = higher in sidebar)
Child nodes Nested dirs/pages, auto-discovered Same weight front matter
Mounts wiki/mounts/<id>/ — normal section tree Committed _index.md; content synced by mount_sync.py

No custom code needed — this is pure Hugo + Hextra.

2. Sidebar Controls Bar

A thin row of control buttons injected above the scrollable nav area (at DOMContentLoaded). Appended as the first child of aside.hextra-sidebar-container (must exist; hidden on mobile).

HTML structure (injected by JS) 

<div class="wiki-sidebar-controls" aria-label="Sidebar controls">
 <button id="wiki-sidebar-theme-toggle" class="wiki-ctrl-btn">tokyo</button>
 <button id="wiki-width-toggle" class="wiki-ctrl-btn"><!-- SVG --></button>
 <button id="wiki-sidebar-collapse" class="wiki-ctrl-btn"><!-- SVG --></button>
</div>

CSS:

.wiki-sidebar-controls {
 display: flex;
 justify-content: flex-end;
}

The theme button has margin-right: auto to push the icon buttons right.

Controls order:

[ tokyo ] [ full-wide ] [ collapse ]
theme layout sidebar

2a. Theme Toggle

  • Cycles: terminal-dark ↔ tokyonight
  • Sets <html data-wiki-theme="tokyonight"> attribute and writes localStorage["wiki-theme"]
  • A second instance lives in the navbar (navbar-end.html). Both read/write the same localStorage key; they stay in sync across page loads. (Not live — label updates on reload).
  • Default theme: tokyonight (seeded + written on first visit; only terminal-dark is treated as an explicit non-default).

2b. Full-width Toggle

  • Adds/removes wiki-fullwide class on <html>
  • CSS removes all of Hextra’s max-width caps:
html.wiki-fullwide .hextra-max-page-width,
html.wiki-fullwide .hextra-max-content-width,
html.wiki-fullwide .hextra-max-navbar-width,
html.wiki-fullwide .hextra-max-footer-width {
 max-width: 100% !important;
}
  • Persisted: localStorage["wiki-fullwide"] || ""

2c. Sidebar Collapse / Expand

  • Collapse button adds wiki-sidebar-collapsed to <html>
  • A floating expand button (position: fixed; top-left) is injected into <body> and shown only when collapsed.
html.wiki-sidebar-collapsed aside.hextra-sidebar-container { display: none !important; }
html.wiki-sidebar-collapsed article.hextra-page-width { max-width: 100% !important; }

.wiki-sidebar-expand-btn {
 position: fixed;
 top: calc(var(--hextra-navbar-height, 4rem) + 8px);
 left: 8px;
 z-index: 30;
 display: none;
}

html.wiki-sidebar-collapsed .wiki-sidebar-expand-btn { display: inline-flex; }
  • Persisted: localStorage["wiki-sidebar-collapsed"]

3. Private Section Gating

Pages/sections with access_type: private (or cascade) are AES-256 encrypted by staticrypt before deployment. The sidebar hides their child titles and redirects unauthenticated users to the encrypted auth page.

Build-time

head-end.html emits an inline JS array of all private section paths:

var WIKI_PRIVATE_SECTIONS = ["/personal/", "/cross-agents-workspace/", ...];

Runtime logic

Per .hextra-sidebar-item that has both a link and a collapsible button:

isPrivate = currentPath in WIKI_PRIVATE_SECTIONS ?
NO → add Link.click → toggle open/close (public default)
YES →
isActiveSection = currentPath.startsWith(sectionPath) ?
NO → btn.click (capture) → redirect to auth page
+ forcibly hide .hextra-sidebar-children (prevent title leak)
YES → add Link.click → toggle open/close (same as public)

Key detail: the redirect handler is capture-phase (addEventListener(..., true)), so it fires before Hextra’s bubble-phase expand handler. When the user is already inside the section (isActiveSection = true), the redirect is skipped and normal expand/collapse is restored — otherwise the hidden state persists across page loads.

4. Drag-to-Resize Sidebar

Hextra hardcodes sidebar width as Tailwind class hx:md:w-64 (256px).

Override via CSS variable 

@media (min-width: 768px) {
 aside.hextra-sidebar-container {
 width: var(--wiki-sidebar-width, 256px) !important;
 min-width: 160px;
 max-width: 520px;
 position: relative; /* needed for absolute drag handle child */
 }
}

JS drag logic

  1. Inject a 5px absolute <div class="wiki-sidebar-resize-handle"> at the right edge
  2. mousedown captures initial width
  3. mousemove clamps to 160–520px and updates --wiki-sidebar-width on <html>
  4. mouseup persists to localStorage["wiki-sidebar-width"]

FOUC prevention

The synchronous inline script at HTML parse time restores the stored width before first paint:

var sw = localStorage.getItem("wiki-sidebar-width");
if (sw) document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--wiki-sidebar-width", sw + "px");

5. FOUC Prevention (All State)

An inline synchronous script in <head> runs before any paint, restoring all persisted states in one pass:

document.documentElement.classList.add("dark"); // always dark

var t = localStorage.getItem("wiki-theme");
if (t === "terminal-dark")
 document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-wiki-theme", "terminal-dark");
if (!t) localStorage.setItem("wiki-theme", "tokyonight"); // seed default

var sw = localStorage.getItem("wiki-sidebar-width");
if (sw) document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--wiki-sidebar-width", sw + "px");

if (localStorage.getItem("wiki-sidebar-collapsed") === "1")
 document.documentElement.classList.add("wiki-sidebar-collapsed");

if (localStorage.getItem("wiki-fullwide") === "1")
 document.documentElement.classList.add("wiki-fullwide");

if (localStorage.getItem("wiki-toc-hidden") === "1")
 document.documentElement.classList.add("wiki-toc-hidden");

No class or attribute toggle is deferred to DOMContentLoaded. Only DOMContentLoaded work is injecting DOM nodes (controls bar buttons) that don’t affect layout dimensions.

6. localStorage Key Reference

Key Stored value Feature
wiki-theme "tokyonight" (default) or "terminal-dark" Active color theme
wiki-sidebar-width Integer string (px), e.g. "320" Drag-resized width
wiki-sidebar-collapsed "1" / "0" Sidebar hidden
wiki-fullwide "1" / "0" Full-width layout
wiki-toc-hidden "1" / "0" Outline panel hidden

7. Outline (TOC) Toggle

Hextra renders the TOC as a sticky right-side panel on wide viewports. Two additions on top of Hextra defaults:

Hide button + Restore button

Hide button — prepended before TOC nav’s first child:

<div class="wiki-toc-controls">
 <button id="wiki-toc-hide" class="wiki-ctrl-btn" aria-label="Hide outline">
 <!-- List-with-X SVG -->
 </button>
</div>
.wiki-toc-controls {
 position: sticky;
 top: 0;
 z-index: 2;
 background: var(--hx-color-dark, #1e1e1e); /* masks scrolling content */
}

html.wiki-toc-hidden nav.hextra-toc { display: none !important; }

Floating restore button — appended to <body>:

<button id="wiki-toc-show" class="wiki-toc-restore-btn" aria-label="Show outline">
 <!-- List-with-arrow SVG -->
</button>
.wiki-toc-restore-btn {
 position: fixed;
 top: calc(var(--hextra-navbar-height, 4rem) + 80px);
 right: 8px;
 z-index: 30;
 display: none;
}

html.wiki-toc-hidden .wiki-toc-restore-btn { display: inline-flex; }
  • Starts at opacity: 0.3; tabindex: -1 (invisible, not focusable)
  • Fades in (opacity: 1) once the page is scrolled past a threshold
  • Click → window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" }) and restores TOC

Back-to-top interaction

When TOC is hidden, the back-to-top button (rendered by themes/hextra/layouts/_partials/toc.html as #backToTop at the bottom of the TOC panel, controlled by themes/hextra/assets/js/core/back-to-top.js) is hidden along with the TOC. This is acceptable — the page can still be scrolled back to top manually or via keyboard. If a standalone scroll-to-top button is needed when TOC is hidden, inject a second equivalent into <body> with similar CSS visibility logic.

Layout

When TOC is hidden, the article column expands automatically because Hextra uses a flex/grid layout — no explicit width override needed.

  • Persisted: localStorage["wiki-toc-hidden"]

8. Implementation Checklist

To replicate all interactions from scratch, these files are needed:

File Purpose
assets/css/custom.css Theme vars, controls bar, collapse, drag, TOC toggle CSS — paste full file
layouts/_partials/custom/head-end.html FOUC script + private gating + controls bar + drag-resize + TOC toggle JS
layouts/_partials/custom/navbar-end.html Theme toggle button in navbar
layouts/_partials/custom/content-begin.html Category/keyword/access badges (separate concern)

All features build on Hextra built-ins — no custom code replaces Hextra’s core rendering. Only the controls bar, private gating, drag-resize, theme toggle, and TOC toggle are custom additions on top of Hextra defaults.

源码私有化与公开发布实施手册

1. 适用场景

适用于以下项目：

  • 使用 Jekyll 或其他静态站点生成器。
  • 站点需要公开访问，但源码、配置、草稿、隐藏内容不应公开。
  • 希望用 GitHub 托管源码，并保留自动构建发布能力。

2. 推荐目录与仓库结构 

private source repo
├── _posts/
├── pages/
├── assets/
├── .github/workflows/
├── internal-docs/
├── scripts/
└── _config.yml

public site repo
└── only built static files from _site/

3. 实施步骤

3.1 清理源码仓库

  • 删除 Git tracking 中的 _site/ 和历史静态 HTML。
  • 恢复源码仓库应有的 Jekyll 目录结构。
  • 将内部说明文档移入 internal-docs/。

3.2 设置发布排除

在 exclude 中至少排除：

  • .github/
  • internal-docs/
  • README.md
  • Gemfile
  • Gemfile.lock
  • 隐藏内容目录，例如 pages/.xusiyuan/

3.3 建立构建脚本

最低要求：

  • 安装 bundler 依赖
  • 清空 _site/
  • 执行 bundle exec jekyll build

3.4 建立安全扫描

扫描重点：

  • OAuth clientSecret
  • access token
  • refresh token
  • GitHub PAT
  • 其他常见 API key

3.5 建立 PR 检查

  • 对 pull_request 运行构建。
  • 名称应稳定，例如 Jekyll Build，以便后续可配置为 required check。

3.6 建立公开发布

  • 使用 deploy key 或机器账号将 _site/ 推送到公开仓库。
  • 发布时只推送构建结果，不复制源码。

3.7 评论系统迁移

避免采用会在浏览器暴露 secret 的评论系统。

优先顺序：

  1. giscus
  2. utterances
  3. 不推荐继续使用需要前端 client_secret 的 Gitalk 前端直连模式

4. 常见故障

4.1 giscus 报错“not installed on this repository”

检查顺序：

  1. 公开仓库是否开启 Discussions
  2. giscus GitHub App 是否安装到目标公开仓库
  3. repoId 和 categoryId 是否匹配目标仓库

4.2 隐藏内容仍然进入 _site

检查：

  • _config.yml 的 exclude
  • 内容路径是否真的位于被排除目录下
  • 是否存在额外脚本把该目录复制进 _site

4.3 PR 检查无法强制拦截合并

原因通常不是 workflow，而是 GitHub 方案不支持私有仓库 branch protection 或 rulesets。

5. 决策原则

  • 公开仓库只保留可公开访问的最终产物。
  • 任何需要保密的内容都不应依赖“前端不显示”来保护。
  • 先用仓库可见性做第一层隔离，再用构建排除做第二层隔离。
  • 先保证部署链可重复，再追求平台集成的完美程度。

落星部落项目改造与权限分离记录

1. 目标

本次改造的核心目标有三项：

  1. 将原先“源码和生成后的静态站点混在同一公开仓库”的状态拆开。
  2. 避免源码、构建配置、隐藏内容和内部记录在公开仓库中暴露。
  3. 建立可重复执行的构建、部署、评论系统和安全检查流程。

2. 改造前问题

改造前存在以下典型问题：

  • 公开仓库直接跟踪 _site/ 和大量生成后的 HTML，源码与产物边界不清。
  • Jekyll 源码、构建依赖、内部说明文档与公开静态页面混在一起。
  • 评论系统曾采用前端暴露 OAuth 敏感信息的方式，存在 P0 级安全风险。
  • pages/.xusiyuan/ 等不应公开的内容源有被错误构建和发布的风险。
  • 构建和发布流程依赖人工操作，容易出现误推送和泄露。

3. 改造过程摘要

3.1 清理历史结构

  • 从 Git tracking 中移除了 _site/ 和原先被提交的静态 HTML 产物。
  • 将站点重新整理为标准 Jekyll 源码仓库结构。
  • 保留并合并了原源码仓库的 commit 历史，避免迁移后失去演进记录。

3.2 拆分源码仓库与公开仓库

  • 当前本地仓库和 origin 用作私有源码仓库。
  • 公开仓库 lothing/lothing.github.io 仅保存构建后的静态产物。
  • 部署时将 _site/ 作为唯一发布内容，强推到公开仓库 master。

3.3 安全整改

  • 移除了前端暴露的 Gitalk OAuth clientSecret 等敏感信息。
  • 采用 giscus 代替需要前端持有 secret 的方案。
  • 新增 secret 扫描工作流，阻止常见前端 secret、token 被再次提交。
  • 通过 _config.yml 的 exclude 规则排除内部文件和隐私内容。

3.4 构建与发布自动化

  • 补齐 Gemfile、Jekyll 版本与本地构建脚本。
  • 建立 scripts/build-site.sh 用于本地和 CI 统一构建。
  • 建立 scripts/deploy-public-site.sh 用于本地一键发布。
  • 建立 GitHub Actions 自动工作流，在私有源码仓库中完成扫描、构建、发布。

3.5 PR 检查

  • 增加 Jekyll Build 工作流，对 PR 和 master push 执行构建验证。
  • 当前仓库所在 GitHub 方案不支持私有仓库 branch protection / rulesets，因此暂时只能提供可见的 PR check，不能平台级强制拦截合并。

4. 最终架构方案

4.1 仓库职责

私有源码仓库：src_lothing_github_io

职责：

  • 保存 Jekyll 源码、文章源文件、页面模板、脚本和工作流。
  • 保存内部文档、迁移记录、部署说明等非公开信息。
  • 执行构建、检查、发布和安全扫描。

不直接对外提供访问。

公开站点仓库：lothing.github.io

职责：

  • 仅保存 _site/ 中的静态发布结果。
  • 为 GitHub Pages 提供公开访问内容。

不保存源码、构建配置、密钥、内部说明和隐藏内容。

4.2 逻辑流程 

私有源码仓库
 -> Secret Scan
 -> Jekyll Build
 -> 生成 _site
 -> 使用 deploy key 推送到公开仓库
 -> GitHub Pages 提供公开访问

4.3 目录边界

公开发布内容：

  • 首页、文章页、静态资源、搜索索引、sitemap 等构建产物。

源码仓库保留但禁止发布的内容：

  • .github/
  • internal-docs/
  • README.md
  • Gemfile / Gemfile.lock
  • MIGRATION_NOTES.md
  • 优化方案.md
  • pages/.xusiyuan/
  • 其他被 _config.yml exclude 排除的路径

5. 具体实现方案

5.1 Jekyll 构建

关键文件：

  • scripts/build-site.sh
  • _config.yml
  • Gemfile

实现要点：

  • 固定 Jekyll 版本与 Bundler 安装路径。
  • 构建前清空 _site/。
  • 统一使用 bundle exec jekyll build。
  • 使用 exclude 防止内部目录误入公开产物。

5.2 自动部署到公开仓库

关键文件：

  • scripts/deploy-public-site.sh
  • .github/workflows/deploy-public-site.yml

实现要点：

  • 源码仓库 remote origin 指向私有仓库。
  • 公开站点仓库 remote public_site 指向 lothing/lothing.github.io。
  • 使用部署专用 SSH key 推送到公开仓库。
  • 发布时将 _site/ 同步到临时目录，追加 .nojekyll，再强推到公开仓库。

5.3 安全控制

关键文件：

  • .github/workflows/secret-scan.yml
  • _config.yml

实现要点：

  • 防止 clientSecret、token、API key 误提交。
  • 私有内容通过源码仓库可见性和构建排除双重控制。
  • 公开仓库中不保留任何需要保密的源文件。

5.4 评论系统

关键文件：

  • assets/js/giscus-config.js
  • assets/js/giscus-comments.js

实现要点：

  • 使用 giscus，避免前端持有 OAuth secret。
  • 目标仓库为公开站点仓库 lothing/lothing.github.io。
  • 依赖 GitHub Discussions 与 giscus GitHub App 安装。

注意：

  • 如果页面报错 giscus is not installed on this repository，首先检查 giscus GitHub App 是否已安装到公开仓库，而不是先怀疑 repoId 或 categoryId。

6. 为什么采用“私有源码仓库 + 公开构建仓库”

这套方案适合当前项目，原因如下：

  • GitHub Pages 公开访问天然依赖公开内容，但源码和内容源并不适合公开。
  • 纯静态站点生成后不需要在公开仓库保留任何构建上下文。
  • 双仓拆分后，访问权限控制最简单，泄露面最小。
  • 发布链路清晰，便于回滚和审计。

7. 可选替代方案

7.1 私有源码仓库 + 外部托管平台直接构建

可选平台：

  • Cloudflare Pages
  • Netlify
  • Vercel

优点：

  • 不需要单独维护公开发布仓库。
  • 预览环境、回滚和部署历史通常更完善。

缺点：

  • 平台迁移和 DNS 配置成本更高。
  • 会引入额外平台依赖。

7.2 私有源码仓库 + 私有内容仓库 / 对象存储

适合更细粒度的内容权限控制场景。

优点：

  • 可以把草稿、隐藏内容、敏感素材进一步拆开。

缺点：

  • 构建链与权限模型更复杂。
  • 对当前纯静态博客场景属于过度设计。

8. 当前方案的边界与限制

  • 当前 GitHub 方案下，私有源码仓库不能使用 branch protection 或 rulesets 来强制 required checks。
  • 因此 PR 构建检查目前是“可见但非平台强制”的状态。
  • 若后续升级 GitHub 方案，应优先补齐 required status checks。

9. 后续建议

建议保持以下演进顺序：

  1. 继续维持双仓模式，不再回到“源码和发布产物混仓”的方式。
  2. 严格通过 _config.yml exclude 管理不应公开的目录。
  3. 将新增内部记录统一写入 internal-docs/。
  4. 若需要更强平台约束，优先升级 GitHub 方案并启用 branch protection / rulesets。
  5. 若需要更优的部署预览与回滚体验，再评估迁移到 Cloudflare Pages 或 Netlify。

内部文档

该目录用于保存站点源码仓库的内部设计、迁移和运维记录。

约束：

  • 该目录仅用于源码仓库内部留档，不参与 Jekyll 构建和公开发布。
  • 构建排除规则见 _config.yml。
  • 若后续有新的迁移、部署或安全改造，应优先追加到本目录。

落星部落 Jekyll Blog 优化方案

分析日期：2026-03-22 项目地址：https://lothing.github.io 当前规模：~27MB，699 个 HTML 页面，3 位作者内容

项目现状概述

本站是一个预编译静态站点，所有 HTML 已生成并直接提交到 Git，缺少 Jekyll 构建基础设施（无 _config.yml、无模板、无 _posts/）。内容为中文学术文章（秦晖、刘军宁、翟学伟三位学者的文章集），通过 GitHub Pages 直接托管。

优化清单（按优先级排序）

🔴 P0 — 安全问题（立即处理）

1. OAuth 凭据硬编码在 HTML 中

问题： 每个页面的 HTML 源码中都包含 Gitalk 的 GitHub OAuth 配置，其中 clientSecret 被直接下发到浏览器。

风险： 凭据明文暴露，任何人都可以用这对密钥冒用你的 GitHub OAuth 应用。

解决方案：

  • Gitalk 的 clientSecret 必须通过后端代理保护，不能直接放在前端
  • 短期方案：在 GitHub OAuth App 设置中限制允许的回调 URL，防止外站滥用
  • 中期方案：部署一个轻量 Serverless 函数（如 Netlify Function / Cloudflare Worker）作为代理，避免前端暴露 Secret
  • 参考：Gitalk 安全说明
  • 如果评论功能使用率低，可考虑移除 Gitalk，改用无需前端持有 secret 的方案（如 utterances 或 giscus）

🟠 P1 — 资产瘦身（高收益低风险）

2. 删除 IE7 Font Awesome 兼容 CSS

文件： assets/css/font-awesome-ie7.min.css（39.3KB） 问题： IE7 于 2016 年已停止支持，全球使用率 < 0.01%，完全无需兼容。 影响： 每页减少 39KB，全站 699 页节省约 27MB 传输量。

操作：

# 删除文件
rm assets/css/font-awesome-ie7.min.css

# 从每个 HTML 页面中删除引用（搜索并替换）
grep -r "font-awesome-ie7" pages/ --include="*.html" -l
# 然后批量移除该行

3. 删除 SVG 格式字体文件

文件： assets/font/fontawesome-webfont.svg（495KB） 问题： SVG 字体格式已被废弃，现代浏览器均不使用。WOFF 格式已足够覆盖 95%+ 现代浏览器。

操作：

rm assets/font/fontawesome-webfont.svg

# 检查 CSS 中的引用并移除 svg 格式声明
grep -n "\.svg" assets/css/font-awesome.min.css
# 从 @font-face src 列表中删除 svg 条目

4. 清理冗余 JavaScript 文件

文件： assets/js/simple-jekyll-search.js（9.5KB）+ simple-jekyll-search.min.js（4.7KB） 问题： 两个文件共存，页面实际只加载其中一个（min 版本），源码版本无需提交。

操作：

# 确认页面加载的是哪个版本
grep -r "simple-jekyll-search" pages/ --include="*.html" | head -5

# 删除未使用的版本
rm assets/js/simple-jekyll-search.js # 如果页面引用的是 .min.js

5. 精简 Font Awesome 字体格式

当前格式： EOT（136KB） + TTF（135KB）+ WOFF（136KB）+ SVG（495KB） 建议保留： 仅 WOFF（现代浏览器）+ EOT（兼容 IE9，如需要） 可删除： TTF（已被 WOFF 覆盖）+ SVG（已废弃） 节省： ~630KB

🟡 P2 — 可维护性提升（中期改进）

6. 添加 .gitignore 文件

问题： 缺少 .gitignore，生成文件和缓存可能被误提交。

建议内容：

# Jekyll 构建输出
_site/
.jekyll-cache/
.jekyll-metadata
# Ruby
.bundle/
vendor/
# macOS
.DS_Store
# 编辑器
.vscode/
.idea/
*.swp

7. 添加 _config.yml 恢复 Jekyll 构建能力

问题： 当前无法通过 jekyll build 重新生成站点，所有内容修改需要手动编辑 HTML。

若想恢复 Jekyll 构建能力，建议最小化 _config.yml：

title: 落星部落
url: "https://lothing.github.io"
baseurl: ""
description: "秦晖、刘军宁、翟学伟文章集"

# 插件
plugins:
 - jekyll-sitemap
 - jekyll-feed

# 排除非内容文件
exclude:
 - README.md
 - Gemfile
 - Gemfile.lock
 - 优化方案.md

注意： 由于当前内容是 .html 文件而非 Markdown，完整迁移到 Jekyll 模板工作量较大，建议充分评估收益后再决定是否执行。

8. 将生成文件从 Git 追踪中移除（可选）

文件： search.json（142KB）、sitemap.xml（130KB） 问题： 这些文件每次内容更新都会改动，增加 Git 历史体积。 方案： 如果恢复 Jekyll 构建流程，可将其纳入 .gitignore 并在 CI 中生成。

🟢 P3 — 长期架构优化（低优先级）

9. 引入 GitHub Actions 自动构建

当前状态： .github/workflows/opencode.yml 仅用于 AI 代码审查，无构建流程。

建议增加构建 workflow：

name: Deploy Jekyll

on:
 push:
 branches: [master]

jobs:
 build-deploy:
 runs-on: ubuntu-latest
 steps:
 - uses: actions/checkout@v4
 - uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
 with:
 ruby-version: '3.2'
 bundler-cache: true
 - run: bundle exec jekyll build
 - uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v3
 with:
 github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
 publish_dir: ./_site

10. 使用模板消除 HTML 重复

问题： 每个 HTML 页面都完整包含 header/footer（约 3-5KB 重复代码），难以统一修改（如更换字体、更新 CDN 链接等）。

长期方案： 将内容迁移为 Markdown + Jekyll layouts，实现：

  • 单点修改 header/footer
  • 自动生成目录和分类页
  • 更小的 Git 历史（Markdown 比 HTML 小 60-80%）

工作量评估： 高（699 个文件需要迁移），建议作为长期目标逐步推进。

11. 图标资源优化

当前： apple-touch-icon.png（3.4KB）+ apple-touch-icon-precomposed.png（3.4KB，内容相同） 操作： 两者内容一致时可删除 -precomposed 版本（iOS 7+ 已不再使用该版本）。

修复 Gitalk Secret 泄露 中 安全风险消除 🔴 立即
删除 IE7 CSS 低 ~27MB 带宽（全站） 🟠 高
删除 SVG 字体 低 495KB 存储 🟠 高
